Commands used: (Make sure to run CMD as administrator)

netsh int ip reset c:\resetlog.txt 

- this resets your internal IP address

netsh winsock reset

- this resets winsock (Winsock is a programming interface and the supporting program that handles input/output requests for Internet applications)

ipconfig /flushdns

- this command flushes and resets a client resolver cache.
